sourceTitle: Debit and Credit Translated from the German of Gustav Freytag
description: "Debit and Credit" by Gustav Freytag is a novel published in 1855. After his father's death, young Anton Wohlfart begins an apprenticeship at a merchant's office in Breslau, where he rises through honest work.
